title: Tests over the repository's live data do not depend on its size
goal: A test that runs a tool over the repository's own live data (such as test_backlog_prompt_end_to_end_without_loading_the_kb over the live backlog) asserts properties that hold at any size of that data, or runs over a fixture, so another session growing the backlog or the kb cannot turn main red; the tests that read live data are listed and each is checked. Answers SP-x2pvljz6: main went red when seven sprints started and horizon alone filled the hook's limit (BG-o3cjsgmm).
